page_title: REI 1-2 BRE | Reims v Brest 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Reims fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+5' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90+3' The ball is out of play. Reims will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
90' Buta (Reims) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
88' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
88' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Substitution. Amadou Kone (Reims) on for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
87' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
85' Substitution. Jonas Martin walks off the pitch and Hugo Magnetti (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
84' Joseph Okumu (Reims) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar.
84' Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
82' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Marshall Munetsi (Reims).
80' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) replaces Sergio Akieme.
80' Oumar Diakite comes off the pitch to be replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
78' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ibrahim Salah (Brest) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
76' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mama Balde and he is replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
74' Sergio Akieme (Reims) jumps into a tackle and Jerome Brisard signals a foul.
74' Sergio Akieme (Reims) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
68' Yaya-Kader Fofana goes off the pitch and Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) comes on.
67' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) has a goal ruled out for offside!
65' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonas Martin (Brest).
63' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
60' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Romain Faivre is replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest).
60' Substitution. Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Edimilson Fernandes walks off.
60' Romain Faivre (Brest) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Joseph Okumu (Reims) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
57' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
55' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Buta (Reims).
52' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
52' The ratio of the ball possession is 61:39.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
46' We are about to witness a substitution. Jordan Amavi (Brest) is replacing Massadio Haidara.
46' The second half has just started.
45+12' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+9' The game is interrupted now, Massadio Haidara (Brest) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+3' Mama Balde (Brest) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf keeps it out with an amazing save.
45+2' Marco Bizot (Brest) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45' 8 additional min. will be played.
45' Junya Ito (Reims) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
44' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) gets inside the box and tries to beat Marco Bizot with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
43' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
41' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
38' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and it's Junya Ito (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Keito Nakamura (Reims) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
34' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Jerome Brisard to decide. The relieved Reims players can finally celebrate.
33' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Reims players aren’t happy.

29' 1 - 2 Joseph Okumu (Reims) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:2.
29' Kenny Lala (Brest) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
27' Reims fail to score from a corner as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.
23' Junya Ito (Reims) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
21' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

18' 0 - 2 GOAL! A great pass finds Mama Balde (Brest) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 0:2.
17' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul after Jonas Martin (Brest) hacks down one of his opponents.
15' Eric Roy is forced to make a change. Luc Zogbe (Brest) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kenny Lala.
12' Luc Zogbe (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
6' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jerome Brisard who sees an offensive foul.
4' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Romain Faivre (Brest) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf no chance!
4' Romain Faivre (Brest) is going to take the penalty!
2' The referee blows his whistle after Joseph Okumu (Reims) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Brest!
2' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Luc Zogbe (Brest) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' The match has just started.
Reims will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
